entities.name: Eugène Marais
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène Nielen Marais was a South African lawyer, naturalist, writer and poète maudit in the Second Language Movement of Afrikaans literature. Since his death by his own hand, Marais has been widely hailed as a literary and scientific genius and a cultural hero of the Afrikaner people.
